issue.title: Trial a Zensical build of sase.sh and decide the post-Material docs stack by 2027-02
issue.description:
Deferred follow-up recorded at the sase-1le landing (plan:202610/sase_sh_docs_redesign.md, section "Out of scope and deferred follow-ups"). Filed by the sase-1le land agent on 2026-10-16.

sase.sh is built with MkDocs Material 9.7. Material's critical-fix support ends 2027-05-05, and its successor is Zensical (0.1.0 planned for 2026-11-05). The docs redesign kept the build Zensical-portable on purpose: check_docs forbids MkDocs `hooks:` and plugins outside an allowlist (search, redirects, blog, rss, exporter in the PDF config only), and every generated page comes from tools/render_* before the build.

Proposal: once Zensical 0.1.0 ships, run a trial build of sase.sh and decide by about 2027-02.
- Acceptance cases: blog, RSS, `_redirects` plus the generated anchor stubs from docs/_meta/moves.yml, the `custom_dir` override (docs/overrides/main.html, the announce banner, the analytics partial), abbr tooltips via pymdownx.snippets auto_append, search quality, the mobile nav drawer, the priority journeys (homepage -> start/first-run, guides, reference lookup), and Zensical's built-in llmstxt and "Copy as Markdown" (which could replace tools/render_docs_map's llms.txt).
- The curated handbook PDF (mkdocs-exporter, pdf_scope = curate) has no Zensical path: it then needs a standalone headless-browser print step, or retirement.
- Fall back to Astro Starlight only if the trial finds durable blockers.
- The URL contract (tools/check_docs_urls, docs/_meta/url_contract.txt) must stay green on the trial build.

task_type_fields.proposal: After Zensical 0.1.0 ships, trial-build sase.sh against the listed acceptance cases (blog, RSS, redirects and anchor stubs, overrides, tooltips, search, mobile nav, journeys, llms.txt) and decide Zensical vs Starlight fallback plus the PDF's future by about 2027-02.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The sase-1le plan listed the Zensical trial as an explicitly deferred follow-up: Zensical 0.1.0 did not exist during the epic, and the trial is a stack decision rather than part of restructuring the docs.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1le docs-redesign plan deferred the Zensical trial to after Zensical 0.1.0 (planned 2026-11-05) and asked the lander to record it; Material's critical-fix window closes 2027-05-05.
